text: Ak Bars Bank's largest shareholders, each above 10% of its capital, are the State Housing Fund under the President of the Republic of Tatarstan (20.41%), the Republic of Tatarstan (19.79%), AO Svyazinvestneftekhim (13.61%) and PAO Tatneft (10.41%), per the bank's Cbonds profile.
short: Tatarstan state bodies and companies are Ak Bars Bank's largest shareholders, above 50% combined.

source.name: Cbonds: Ак Барс Банк company profile
source.quote: Крупнейшими акционерами банка, с долей более 10% капитала, являются: Государственный жилищный фонд при Президенте РТ – 20.41%, Республика Татарстан – 19.79%, АО Связьинвестнефтехим – 13.61%, ПАО Татнефть – 10.41%
source.note: Translation: 'The bank's largest shareholders, holding more than 10% of capital, are: the State Housing Fund under the President of the Republic of Tatarstan – 20.41%, the Republic of Tatarstan – 19.79%, AO Svyazinvestneftekhim – 13.61%, PAO Tatneft – 10.41%.' Date of the profile's information not stated on the page; the site is current (news feed to 2026). Single independent source found: the bank's own site and e-disclosure block scripted access.
